title: The Unhurt Pilot
surface: A pilot is controlling a plane when it hits a tree and breaks apart. The pilot never jumps out, leaves the operating position or uses protective equipment, yet suffers no scratch. It is a real aircraft, not a game or recording. How?
solution: It is a radio-controlled model aircraft. Its operator has been standing on the ground with the transmitter the whole time. The model crashes, but nobody is aboard it.

facts.text: The aircraft is a real flying radio-controlled model.
Its operator remains on the ground and is never inside it.
This is not a simulator, special effect or recorded scene.

unknowns: The model’s dimensions, price and operator’s age are unspecified.
hints: Must a pilot sit inside the aircraft being controlled?
A real aircraft need not be full-size.
The operator stands on the ground holding a transmitter.
